region: Balasore & Bhadrak Coastal Belt (near Dhamra/Bahanaga), Odisha
alert_summary: Very Severe Cyclonic Storm Yaas (IMD track 25-26 May 2021) approaching northern Odisha coast near Balasore/Dhamra with 130-140 km/h winds, heavy rainfall, and storm surge inside the Bhuvan 5km High Impact Buffer.
recommended_action: Evacuate low-lying coastal settlements within the 5km High Impact Buffer immediately, secure shelter, and complete your safety check-in.

precautions.text: Leave low-lying coastal villages inside the 5km High Impact Buffer and move to a designated cyclone shelter.
Turn off main electricity and gas connections before surge/flooding enters and stay away from glass windows.
Pack drinking water, dry rations, torch, power bank, essential medicines, and waterproofed ID documents.
Keep battery conserved and respond to safety check-ins promptly; unacknowledged alerts escalate to family and rescue teams.
